title: Chanvoy wait_channel_v3 Successful Result
description: A successful first-match result. Clean deadman and hard failures, including ownership conflicts, are JSON-RPC errors, not successful results.

root_id.description: Top-level posts carry their own id; replies carry the thread root id.

channel.description: Requested channel selector echoed on match. Canonical team/channel for conflicts live on error data, not here.

wait_id.description: Opaque id of the waiter that matched. Optional diagnostic; absence does not change match meaning.

replaced_wait_id.description: Present when this waiter was admitted by compare-and-replace. Optional diagnostic only.
